description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 10th September 2025 (RN:24/05375/FULL) for the Demolition of No 47 Ebury Mews and the erection of a two-storey replacement mews building with new basement level. Alterations and refurbishment to No. 47 Chester Square including demolition of modern rear additions, reinstatement of  lower ground floor lightwell to the rear and extension of existing lower ground floor. Construction of ground floor link from 47 Chester Square to 47 Ebury Mews, consolidation of amenity courtyard at ground floor level, other internal and external works of refurbishment to 47 Chester Square namely, to allow rebuilding of the rear of the top floor mansard roof to the main house with new dormer windows and new monopitch rooflight to the stairwell below; awning removed to the closet wing; downpipes re-routed to rear elevation of main house; revisions to detailed design of glazed link; front door to Ebury Mews entrance enlarged and addition of flues above roof to the mews house.
